summary: A guide for authors of documents that add new encryption or authentication algorithms to ESP and AH. It maps out how the IPsec documents relate to one another so that new pieces follow a consistent structure. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 6071.

eli5.summary: This is a map of a big pile of IPsec documents. It shows which ones to read and where a new one should fit in.

questions: what is the ipsec document roadmap
